environment.description: Same Quarkus 3.2 handler deployed on AWS Lambda behind API Gateway. The RDS PostgreSQL 15 instance uses a dedicated database role 'oauth_ro_lambda' configured at the RDS parameter group level with a row-level security policy. The role was provisioned via Terraform with: GRANT SELECT ON oauth_codes TO oauth_ro_lambda; (no INSERT, UPDATE, or DELETE grants exist for this role on any table in the schema). The Quarkus datasource connects using this role via IAM database authentication (rds-db:connect). Note: the application code still attempts INSERT in storeAuthCode() but this will throw a PSQLException with SQLSTATE 42501 (insufficient_privilege), causing the /oauth/authorize endpoint to return HTTP 500 before any redirect occurs. The authorization code is never persisted, so the /oauth/token endpoint cannot look it up, and no token is ever issued regardless of redirect_uri validation bypass.

config.db_privileges: SELECT ONLY on oauth_codes (provisioned via Terraform aws_db_instance + null_resource provisioner executing GRANT SELECT ON oauth_codes TO oauth_ro_lambda; REVOKE INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE ON oauth_codes FROM oauth_ro_lambda;)
config.iam_auth: rds-db:connect IAM policy bound to Lambda execution role
config.network: API Gateway REST API with Lambda proxy integration
config.rls_policy: none needed - role simply lacks write permission
config.effect_on_exploit: storeAuthCode() fails with PSQLException 42501, endpoint returns 500, no auth code persisted, token exchange impossible
